title: Merchant Commerce Adapter v1 schemas
description: Complete normative JSON Schema 2020-12 definitions for the platform-neutral merchant commerce adapter contract. The OpenAPI document references these local definitions.

ResourceRef.description: Opaque merchant-native identifier meaningful only within the authenticated merchant scope.

Money.description: Integer minor-unit money resolved by the merchant; never a client authority.

SubjectContext.description: Server-derived identity and delegation context. It is not browser-supplied authority.

ExtensionMap.description: Optional namespaced extension members. Generic consumers must not require them.

CloudEvent.description: Structured CloudEvents v1.0.2 representation. CloudEvents requires specversion, id, source, and type; this contract additionally requires subject, time, datacontenttype, merchantid, contractversion, and data.

SearchCatalogResponse.description: Common response envelope for searchCatalog; data is the normalized SearchCatalogData model.
